what_it_does: Improves the efficiency of hardware circuits that perform modular reduction—a critical math operation in cryptographic systems like homomorphic encryption and zero-knowledge proofs—for very large numbers (128 to 8192 bits). The approach uses lookup tables to speed up computation but minimizes the memory area required by decomposing the operation into two complementary subtasks and distributing their execution strategically, trading off computation between stages while maintaining throughput.
